reason: Language proposal

title: add netrc parsing support for package manager
reason: Feature request

title: Dogfood the self-hosted WebAssembly backend when generating zig1.wasm

title: x86_64 SysV: LLVM backend passes 16-byte extern structs wrongly when the C function also has float arguments

reason: SPIR-V backend only.

reason: sparc64 LLVM 23 issue; exotic arch and not in 0.17.1.

reason: Reproduced on 0.17.1: failed fetch leaves .tmp-* dir behind; disk leak only, noted in cb37053.

reason: Reproduced on 0.17.1: zig fetch without --save leaves tmp/ and caches a nested tarball, causing hash mismatch later.

title: `zig init` produces code that can't compile when the directory name collides with an identifier in the template (eg: `main`)
